title: Tensor Completion using Subspace Information
abstract: arXiv:2609.24501v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tensor completion has attracted significant attention in both applications and theoretical research. Under standard uniform sampling, existing polynomial-time guarantees generally require more observations than the number of degree of freedom, motivating the study of a possible statistical-to-computational gap in highly missing regimes. Fortunately, in many practical scenarios, side information is available, which can provide valuable insights to mitigate these challenges. In this paper, we introduce an algorithm called Tensor Completion using Subspace Information (TCSI) that incorporates side information through an estimated subspace. Our approach first extracts the subspace from the available side information and then reformulates tensor completion as a matrix regression problem. We provide a theoretical analysis showing that, when accurate subspace information is available, the required sample complexity is reduced to nearly linear

translated_title: 基于子空间信息的张量补全
translated_abstract: 张量补全在应用和理论研究领域都受到了广泛关注。在标准均匀采样下，现有的多项式时间保证通常需要比自由度数量更多的观测值，这促使人们研究在高缺失情形下可能存在的统计-计算差距。幸运的是，在许多实际场景中，辅助信息是可获得的，它能提供有价值的见解来缓解这些挑战。本文提出了一种名为“基于子空间信息的张量补全”（TCSI）的算法，该算法通过估计的子空间来融入辅助信息。我们的方法首先从可用的辅助信息中提取子空间，然后将张量补全重新表述为一个矩阵回归问题。我们提供了理论分析，表明当准确的子空间信息可用时，所需的样本复杂度可降低到接近线性。
tldr: 本文提出TCSI算法，通过从辅助信息中提取子空间并将张量补全转化为矩阵回归问题，在子空间信息准确可用时将所需样本复杂度降低到接近线性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the TCSI algorithm, which extracts a subspace from side information and reformulates tensor completion as a matrix regression problem, reducing the required sample complexity to nearly linear when accurate subspace information is available.
